notablePrerequisites: You control a Treasure token, and at least one creature.
description:
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing a Treasure, creating two 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Activate Prosperous Partnership by tapping the Citizens and another creature, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Stimulus Package twice by sacrificing the Treasures, creating four 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Activate Prosperous Partnership by tapping three Citizens, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 3.
